现有 SmolVLA 任务模型的共同配置为：三个相机、12 维真实动作、50 步: The existing SmolVLA task models share these settings: three cameras, 12-dimensional real actions, 50-step action chunks, maximum state and action dimensions of 32, images padded to 512×512, a frozen vision encoder, and training of the expert and state projection. Before training, replace `YOUR_NAME/YOUR_DATASET` in the command with the actual dataset, then open `BREE/configs/smolvla_train.json` and replace both occurrences of `YOUR_RUN` with the training-run name. 当前命令冻结 XVLA 的视觉和语言编码器，只训练策略 Transformer: The current command freezes XVLA's vision and language encoders and trains only the policy Transformer and soft prompts, keeping GPU memory use relatively low. To fine-tune the full VLM, set both `freeze` parameters to `false`, but expect substantially higher memory use and training time.
